taskRules.target: Sort notes by onset, then pitch, then ID. From index floor(n/2), take the first note whose pitch/onset address is unique and whose edited result neither collides with another note address nor leaves MIDI range 0-127. Instances sharing a window choose in instance order; a later instance skips notes already targeted.
taskRules.velocity: Transcriptions carry placeholder velocity 64, so real windows receive synthetic dynamics from r01-pilot-velocity-v1: per-work base 64-84, phrase depth 6-12 and phase 0-7 quarters; per note, beat accent +6 (+4 more on a four-quarter downbeat) within 1/16 quarter of a beat, +2 within 1/16 of an off-beat, a triangular eight-quarter phrase swell, register emphasis round((pitch - median pitch) / 6) clamped to +/-4, and jitter -5..5; rounded and clamped to 20-120. They are not recovered performance dynamics.
taskRules.shiftRange: The first of [4,6), [6,8), [8,10), [10,12) containing at least two onsets whose shifted result has no pitch/onset collision.
taskRules.editVelocity: 91, or 37 if the target velocity is already 91.
taskRules.synthetic: Seeded SHA-256 draws from r01-pilot-synthetic-v1. p02/p04 spreads are even 1/512 cells; p07 (revision 4) uses six members with odd and even cells, so halving leaves the 1/512 grid.
taskRules.sounding: Work C. T is the note onset nearest quarter 8 (earlier on a tie) at which another note ends and a third note is held across (onset < T < end); a note sounds at T when onset <= T < onset + duration.
taskRules.transposePitch: Work C. Among pitches with 5-10 notes, by descending count then ascending pitch, the first whose notes can all move up two semitones within MIDI range without landing on an existing pitch/onset address.
taskRules.shiftTransposeRange: Work A. Over distinct onsets F >= 4 in ascending order, T is the first distinct onset >= F + 2; take the first [F, T) holding 4-12 notes whose shifted (+1/8) and transposed (+2) results collide with no other address. Both bounds are note onsets.
taskRules.nearMiss: Work B. Same-pitch onset pairs x < y with y - x <= 1 quarter, by x in the edit-target order from the median and excluding the p05 target; F = floor(x) and T = y, and x must be the only note of that pitch in [F, T). The note at T lies just outside the half-open range.
